title: Moving Furniture
answer:
Dear Jim,

I am writing this email to explain why I cannot help you move your furniture.

Firstly, I would like to thank you for inviting me, but I am not able to help you move your furniture. Actually, my boss has asked me to work overtime, and I cannot delay it.

The other reason is that I do not have reliable transportation to get to your place, and my car is in the garage for repair.

Lastly, my family needs me this weekend, and my sister has promised to come to my home, so we can have dinner together.

Best regards,
Dhruv

title: Hot Water & Noise
answer:
Dear Marin,

I am writing this email to explain two things that I am currently facing in my apartment.

Firstly, I would like to draw your attention to my noisy neighbours, who often play loud music late at night. The hot water system is also malfunctioning again, despite having been repaired.

Additionally, the loud music greatly impacts me, and I cannot sleep very well. Due to the unavailability of hot water, I am not able to perform household chores like bathing and cleaning properly.

Lastly, I would like to suggest that you call the plumber to fix this issue and take strict action against my neighbours for playing loud music.

Best regards,
Dhruv

title: Company of a Friend
answer:
Dear Jim,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing this email to ask about some basic information.

Firstly, I would like to inform you that I am expected to give my presentation at your company this coming Friday at 10 a.m. I would like to confirm a few details about the venue to ensure everything runs smoothly.

Additionally, can you let me know which technology and equipment will be available? I would like to confirm whether there will be computers, projectors, and other necessary equipment.

Lastly, it would be helpful to know the expected number of participants so I can arrange handouts and prepare my presentation slides.

Best regards,
Dhruv

title: Lost Bag
answer:
Dear Restaurant Manager,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing this email regarding my bag that I lost at your restaurant.

Firstly, I would like to describe the incident that happened yesterday. Actually, my friends and I dined at your restaurant last evening, and we were sitting at a table near your kitchen.

Additionally, it is a red leather Michael Kors bag with a golden buckle and a black logo. It may contain essential documents, including my passport and driving licence.

Lastly, if you find my bag, please call me. I will pick up my bag at your convenience.

Best regards,
Dhruv

title: Stairs Light
answer:
Dear Building Manager,

I am writing this email regarding the poor lighting in our building, and I want to suggest some improvements. I live on the second floor of an apartment building with one elevator.

Firstly, I think we need to install more lights along the stairs and in common areas, which can ensure not only visibility at all times but also reduce the risk of mishaps.

Additionally, I feel that replacing the existing bulbs with brighter lights would be greatly convenient for all residents, especially for older people.

Finally, I would suggest installing motion-sensing lights as an ideal way to reduce energy consumption in our building.

Best regards,
Dhruv

title: Movie Invitation
answer:
Dear Friend,

I am writing this email to apologize for not being able to go with you to see the movie.

Firstly, I would like to thank you for inviting me. It is really thoughtful of you, and I really appreciate you thinking of me.

Additionally, I would like to tell you the main reason why I cannot come with you to see the movie. Actually, my boss gave me one task that I need to do late tonight, and I cannot delay it.

Lastly, I suggest that we should make a good plan to see the movie on another day together.

Best regards,
Dhruv

title: Birthday Party
answer:
Dear Parents,

I am writing this email to invite your children to take part in my child's birthday party.

Firstly, I would like to inform you when and where the party will be held. The party will be held at Sunshine at 8 p.m. this Friday.

Additionally, both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food items will be served at the party. Apart from this, every guest will be welcomed with special drinks and party hats.

In order to make the party more exciting and entertaining, we have arranged some fun activities, especially for the children, such as tug-of-war and a craft station.

I hope you accept my invitation.

Best regards,
Dhruv

title: Birthday Reservation
answer:
Dear Restaurant Manager,

I am writing this email to make a group booking for 20 people, as you do not allow online bookings for more than 6 people.

Firstly, I would like to book your kitchen for 20 people this Friday at 10 p.m. The reservation is being made so my guests do not have to wait in long queues.

I believe it is important for me to discuss some details of the birthday party. I want you to welcome every guest with some special drinks and party hats.

Lastly, I request that you assign us a separate parking area just outside your kitchen so that my guests do not face any trouble while parking their cars.

Best regards,
Dhruv

title: New Neighbour
answer:
Dear Neighbour,

I am writing this email to address some issues that I am currently facing in my apartment.

Firstly, I would like to shed some light on the issues related to excessive noise, particularly at night. Loud music greatly impacts me.

Additionally, I have some other parking problems that I cannot ignore. Our building management team has already assigned separate parking spots for everyone, so please make sure you park your car in your parking spot.

Lastly, I have concerns related to garbage disposal as well. Our community team has already assigned separate bins for dry and wet waste, so please make sure to put all your garbage in the right bins.

Best regards,
Dhruv

title: Vacation for 2 Weeks
answer:
Dear Danis,

I am writing this email to take a vacation for 2 weeks.

Firstly, I would like to inform you of my exact vacation dates, which will begin on June 15th and conclude on June 29th, 2026.

Additionally, I believe that you know the main reason behind my leave. The main reason is to take time off because I want to spend some quality time with my friends and family members.

Lastly, during my absence, Anna will cover all my shifts, and she can also take over my projects and responsibilities. She already has my number, so whenever she needs any help, she can contact me.

Best regards,
Dhruv

title: Company Energy
answer:
Dear Mrs. Smith,

I am writing this email to offer you some suggestions related to energy reduction. My company is trying to save energy.

Firstly, I would like to highlight the importance of turning off the lights when not required, which will help lower the consumption of electricity in our club.

Additionally, I believe that all players need to turn off the machines and lights after completing their tasks.

Finally, I think we do not need air-conditioners and heaters because now the outdoor weather is quite pleasant, so we can use inverter AC and heaters as they consume less energy.

Best regards,
Dhruv

title: Party Suggestions
answer:
Dear Mrs. Singh,

I am writing this email to give three suggestions regarding the party.

Firstly, I would like to propose a mix of upbeat and classical music that can cater to all age groups. A live band could keep the energy high, encouraging everyone to dance.

Additionally, I believe that a buffet with diverse options would be ideal for the party. You should consider including vegetarian and non-vegetarian foods that can cater to all dietary preferences.

Lastly, we should organize fun team-oriented activities such as tug-of-war and a craft station.

I hope these suggestions are helpful.

Best regards,
Dhruv
